about: Labour markup per recipe kind: a route's value is (consumed ingredients x (1 + pct) + flat + kept tools x toolFraction) / output quantity + perItem. pct and flat are per batch; perItem (optional, default 0) is gears added to each output item after the division, for work that scales with the volume: a liquid is 100 portions a litre, so a flat per batch is nothing per portion, and curing's 0.002 per portion is 0.2 gears a litre of cider or wine. minBatchLitres (optional) spreads the flat of a recipe whose output is a liquid over at least that many litres: the barrel's recipes for cider (a portion), mead (0.1 L), wine vinegar and yogurt starter are run by the barrelful, so their 0.1 is charged per litre, not per portion. Kinds are recipe types (grid, smithing, knapping, clayforming, barrel, cooking, alloy, construction), 'transition' (drying, ripening, smoking, melting, hardening, ...), 'lottery' (an item decided by chance: no labour; the other outcomes are credited, see README.md), the item attributes the export carries (smelting, baking, crushing, grinding, pressing: the fruit press, distilling: the still, whose route is per input portion, so it has no flat), and 'mod' for every other mod registry; any recipe type can have its own entry by its type code, as 'curing' (ageing: cider into wine and spirits, yogurt, jerky) has. The barrel has no perItem: its cheap liquids (dyes, tannin) go into other things by the litre, and a per-portion charge would double dyed leather. See README.md.

voxelsPerUnit.about: Smithing and clay forming use their material by volume: the material slot counts filled voxels / voxels per unit when its code contains 'match' (an ingot is 42 voxels, a lump of clay 25); otherwise (an iron bloom) the stack as given.

schematicsAbout: Schematics (Trading/Schematics: config/schematic-gates.json's 'sold'; traders are their only source): kept on crafting, worth nothing. A slot that takes only schematics is dropped from the route (it adds nothing and never blocks it), and a schematic is never priced: no raw, default or fallback, and no route makes one.
